grammar.title: The Passato Prossimo with Reflexive Verbs and Formal Register
grammar.explanation: In professional Italian, reflexive verbs in the passato prossimo always use 'essere' as the auxiliary, and the past participle agrees with the subject: 'mi sono candidato/a' (I applied), 'si è dimesso/a' (he/she resigned). In formal business contexts, use 'Lei' (capitalized) instead of 'tu': 'Si è candidato per la posizione?' (Did you apply for the position? - formal). The formal register also uses the conditional for polite requests: 'Potrebbe inviarmi il curriculum?' (Could you send me the resume?).
